title: Robust issue-URL parsing with GitHub Enterprise support
plan:
Implement robust GitHub issue URL parsing (with InvalidIssueUrlError), support GitHub Enterprise hosts, normalize stored URLs, use enterprise Octokit baseUrl, validate URLs in API endpoints, and add unit tests.
1. Implement parseIssueUrl, InvalidIssueUrlError, and enterprise Octokit baseUrl
2. Validate and normalize issue URLs in API routes (create task and retry)
3. Add vitest tests for parseIssueUrl
requirements: Implement parseIssueUrl(issueUrl:string) that returns { host, owner, repo, issueNumber } and accepts https://github.com/o/r/issues/12 with trailing slash, ?query, #fragment, www.github.com, and hosts listed in comma-separated env GITHUB_HOSTS
parseIssueUrl must throw InvalidIssueUrlError for pull requests (/pull/), non-numeric or zero issue numbers, unknown hosts, http:// URLs, and owner/repo names with invalid characters
Octokit client in GithubApi constructor uses baseUrl: https://<host>/api/v3 for enterprise hosts (hosts other than github.com)
Orchestrator uses parsed host when constructing the clone URL (embedding token if present)
POST /api/task validates the issue URL and returns 400 { error: <message> } when parseIssueUrl throws InvalidIssueUrlError; stored task uses normalized URL https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n>
POST /api/task/:taskId/retry validates the issue URL similarly and returns 400 for InvalidIssueUrlError; stored/updated task uses normalized URL
Add vitest tests at backend/src/GithubApi/__tests__/parseIssueUrl.test.ts covering at least 10 accepted/rejected cases
